description_en: Property features: 4-Storey Villa Farke, Tirana 2 minutes from Teg shopping center and 5 minutes from Lake Farke Total area 290 m² Construction area 234 Price 1613euro/m² Property organization: • 2 winter and summer salons • Cooking area • Distribution corridor • 3 bedrooms • 4 bathrooms • Gym • 2 places parking ✨ 4-storey villa for sale in the newest residential complex West Home Residence, only 2 minutes away from the TEG shopping center. The villa was built with the highest quality Italian materials, designed in detail by the architects and organized in 3 floors above ground and 1 floor below ground. 2 dedicated parking spaces for each. The 1st floor is organized by recreational space, technical room and toilet. Floor 0 is organized by distribution corridor, kitchen, living room, veranda, toilet and parking post. The 1st floor is organized by a veranda, two bedrooms, a distribution corridor and a toilet. The 2nd floor consists of bedrooms, a toilet, a veranda. The property offers privacy and a comfortable family life near nature, it has a yard, a parking lot. The villa is still under construction, where the entire complex is expected to be completed within the 5-year deadline. The property offers privacy, tranquility and a comfortable family life close to nature. Also a very good investment. The area where it is located is quite quiet and very close to the capital Property Organization: • 3 living rooms • 1 kitchen and dining room • 3 distribution corridors • 3 bedrooms • 4 toilets • 1 yard extending in three directions • Verandah Agent: Ediola Sllogu For more detailed information contact us!
